text: Here are four nuts from fine-tuning. You've already met one. <short pause> No exact initialisation lets LoRA reach an update of rank above twice its own. LoRA-plus is LoRA with alpha rescaled. GaLore is one-sided LoRA with a moving frame. And exactly orthogonal methods never change a weight's singular values, however often you merge them. <short pause> Each sounds like a separate fact with its own clever proof, and most were first proved that way. We won't crack them again. We'll raise the sea, and watch them dissolve.
